integration.source: Synthetic stable user tokens and preclassified records, including duplicate, multi-bucket and ineligible records. No real raw-data classifier.
pipeline: atomic encrypted count/histogram snapshot pair and batch provenance
two-level signed delegated concurrent analysis clients
durable full randomness and unique committed outputs
retention-v2 L3 and signed full-result envelope
recipient logical GC and authenticated historical archive verification
integration.fresh_database: New exact storage profiles; no migration or downgrade to either separate parent profile.
integration.combined_schema: Contribution and v2 delivery tables included in same witnessed image before bootstrap.
integration.recovery_audits: Both contribution pair/roster audit and retention-v2 evidence/frontier audit execute before recovery commit. Negative tests deliberately create authority-accepted inconsistent states to ensure neither audit is skipped.
integration.tls: Requires actual TLSWitnessClient; no ReferenceWitness fallback for authenticated profile.
integration.writer: No raw records/roster/snapshot argument; signed accepted envelopes and pinned operation set only; Python adapter has no enforced OS isolation.

validation.process_crash_scope: Six local reference-authority subprocess exits in combined profile; distinct from loopback workflow reply-loss injections. Not power-loss or cross-host fault-domain testing.
validation.ingestion_interruption: After actual authenticated witness CAS receipt, before local commit; old replica fenced, original pair restored without compiler rerun. This is not a dropped RPC response.
validation.scheduler_interruption: After local and authority result commit, API reply lost; same request retry after reopen retains seed, output and account state.
validation.recipient_interruption: Actual receiver transaction commits then socket ACK dropped; same envelope retry after credential revocation preserves first acceptance.
extra_local_cases: expired terminal reconciliation reads no result/snapshot and gives no refund
accepted/closed terminal facts retire and verify through archive
fresh replica restore keeps source pair, random tape, outputs and retirement evidence
recovery rejects a bad contribution pair even when v2 delivery audit passes
recovery rejects bad v2 root even when source audit passes
validation.maximum_dimensions: Full workflow B4 N3 only; existing compiler B64 N65535 and wire-width tests are separate evidence.

Scalable authenticated history/resource admission and independent interoperability
